descriptions.cxc2_records_8020fac8: Lazily initialize the three twelve-byte records at external storage 0x80463bbc when flag 0x804b06b4 is zero. Clear each record through 0x802eefe0; install tables 0x8040c980/0x8040c990 and words 12/1 in the first two; leave the third cleared; set the flag to one. Return the aggregate address. Field meanings and data ownership remain unresolved.
